task.ques: Weight lose for a male with current weight 90 kg, 40 year old, 175 cm. If he intakes 1500 calories every day, how long will it take to lose 17 kg.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: WolframAlpha estimates 3 months and 6 days to lose 17 kg (from 90 kg to 73 kg) for a 40-year-old male, 175 cm tall, consuming 1,500 dietary Calories per day, assuming a sedentary activity level.
Evidence: WolframAlpha's input information matches all supplied values, and its "Weight loss regimen duration" states: "intake 1500 Cal/d for 3 months 6 days to lose 17 kg with a sedentary activity level".
Source: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=weight+loss+male+90+kg+40+years+old+175+cm+1500+calories+per+day+lose+17+kg

Accessed: October 27, 2026.
